provenance_note: Households use 2020-2024 ACS B19001 and workers/work-from-home use B08301 for Manhattan Census Tracts 238.02 and 238.03, a documented Roosevelt Island proxy. Approximate 90% MOEs: 3,622 households ±404; 3,707 workers ±509; 828 working from home ±237. ACS direct-mode counts are Subway 1,881, Bus 137, and Ferry 74; the transit share is these 2,092 workers divided by 2,879 in-person workers, and the mode split is normalized across those three modes. ACS Rail (26 workers) is excluded from independent RI capacity because there is no commuter-rail boarding service on the island; first-leg access is unknown. ACS has no Tram category, so its zero baseline split is not evidence of zero Tram riders; the Tram is available only in the full-reallocation scenario. The selected weekday 07:00-08:00 schedule has 8 southbound M trains (1,100 passengers/train retained as the spec planning capacity at your direction) and 4 Q102 departures to Queens. The Astoria Ferry has 3 island departures, represented by a 20-minute equivalent headway despite irregular actual gaps.
